body.name: Finite-sample simultaneous confidence union
body.construction: If \(2\tau_N<\epsilon_0\) and \(b_N<\min\{a,\delta\}/2\), set \(\mathcal U_{xy}=\bigcup_{j\in\widehat J_x}[\widehat C_{yj}/\widehat C_{xj}-w_N,\widehat C_{yj}/\widehat C_{xj}+w_N]\); otherwise set \(\mathcal U_{xy}=[-a^{-1},a^{-1}]\)
